status_statement: This dictionary is a reviewable research artifact. It is not a clinical feature standard, not a validated input schema, and not supervisor-approved. Only the panel explicitly marked executable may be used by the guarded internal run after a separate human authorization. Schema 1.1.0 is Amendment A-1 (2026-10-24): a source-value encoding correction for six admitted predictors whose delivered cells are numeric 0/1. No column, panel membership, ordering, model, seed, fold, metric, threshold or privacy rule changes, and no new authorization is implied: the previous hash-bound authorization does not cover these bytes.

revision_history.change: Initial registered research feature dictionary (M3a / D-048 proposal).
revision_history.source_value_evidence: Vocabulary tokens for twelve binary predictors were registered from secondary literature with vocabulary_evidence_status SECONDARY_*_UNVERIFIED; no human inspection of the local workbook had occurred.

revision_history.change: Corrected the source-value encoding of exactly six admitted predictors (DM, HTN, Current Smoker, EX-Smoker, FH, Typical Chest Pain) from the assumed Y/N/Yes/No text vocabulary to the audited numeric 0/1 representation. The other six admitted categorical predictors (Sex, DLP, Atypical, Nonanginal, Exertional CP, Dyspnea) keep their registered text vocabularies unchanged. Model-side codes stay 0/1, so the executable panel, its order, its reference coding and its 16 encoded parameters are unchanged.
revision_history.evidence: Human-executed, read-only, SHA-256-verified local audit of all 303 DA-A1 records (2026-10-24): the six columns contain exclusively numeric 0/1 cells with no blanks; the workbook bytes were verified identical before and after the audit. Supporting (not authoritative) secondary literature: doi:10.3390/electronics11030315 Table 1 and PMC7037941. Dataset identity: doi:10.24432/C5Q31T.
revision_history.residual_uncertainty: The audit establishes the representation (numeric 0/1). The direction (0 = absent/false, 1 = present/true) is a provisional inference supported by the attribute names and secondary literature, not by an official per-column codebook. Flagged as S-9 for explicit human acceptance.
revision_history.authorization_impact: Changing this file changes its SHA-256 and the panel/dictionary version the local authorization manifest binds. Any manifest signed against schema 1.0.0 / panel 1.0.0 fails closed and a new human decision plus a new local manifest are required.

panels.display_name: Basic Clinical Input Panel (history, symptoms, vital signs)
panels.intended_moment: First clinical assessment of a patient referred for consideration of coronary angiography, before angiography is performed.
panels.rationale: Prespecified from clinical availability and workflow, not from any correlation, univariate result, or model performance. The panel contains only variables recorded by history, symptom characterisation, and vital signs at intake: age, sex, BMI, five cardiovascular risk-factor history items, five chest-pain/dyspnoea descriptors, and resting blood pressure and pulse rate. It excludes all test-dependent data (ECG, laboratory, echocardiography), the outcome, identifiers, and redundant anthropometric duplicates.
panels.prespecification_statement: No member was added because it improved apparent accuracy; the panel is fixed before any real-data fitting and may only change through a documented protocol amendment with a new schema version.
limitations: Availability is inferred from the feature group and the clinical workflow; the source does not document per-field acquisition time.
Predictive value is unproven; no feature was selected from data.
Parameter count and events are not a sample-size justification (see sample_size.py status).
panels.encoded_parameter_count_note: Four continuous fields + twelve binary fields under reference coding = 16 parameters before any interaction.
panels.source_value_encoding_note: Twelve of the sixteen panel members are binary. Six of them (DM, HTN, Current Smoker, EX-Smoker, FH, Typical Chest Pain) are numeric 0/1 in the delivered workbook and are mapped explicitly; the other six (Sex, DLP, Atypical, Nonanginal, Exertional CP, Dyspnea) keep their registered text vocabularies. Model-side codes remain 0/1 with reference coding, so this remains 16 encoded parameters.

panels.display_name: Basic Clinical Input Panel + resting ECG block
panels.intended_moment: Same assessment moment, only if a resting 12-lead ECG was actually recorded before the angiography decision.
panels.rationale: Registered expansion; blocked because the source does not document ECG acquisition timing relative to angiography (L-08-CLIN).
blockers: Documented source/clinician evidence that the seven ECG findings were recorded before the angiography decision.
Protocol amendment and a new schema version.

panels.display_name: Expanded clinical panel (additional history and examination findings)
panels.intended_moment: Same assessment moment; adds secondary comorbidities, examination findings, functional class and low-threshold angina.
panels.rationale: Registered expansion; blocked because the additional parameters are not justified by the available events and several definitions are undocumented.
blockers: Documented definitions for Function Class and LowTH Ang.
Protocol amendment and a new schema version.

panels.display_name: Basic Clinical Input Panel + laboratory block
panels.intended_moment: Same assessment moment, only if laboratory results were available before the angiography decision.
panels.rationale: Registered expansion; blocked because laboratory units and collection timing relative to angiography are unverified (L-08-LAB).
blockers: Verified units and reference ranges from the source documentation.
Evidence that results preceded the angiography decision.
Protocol amendment and a new schema version.

source_value_encoding.semantic_interpretation: PROVISIONAL: source value 0 = absent/false, source value 1 = present/true. Retained model-side codes are 0 and 1, so the encoded predictor is unchanged.
semantic_evidence: Human-executed read-only SHA-256-verified local audit (2026-10-24): the column contains only numeric 0/1 cells across 303/303 records.

PMC7037941 published feature descriptions support a 0/1 representation.
Attribute naming (a risk factor present/absent) makes 1 = present the natural reading.
source_value_encoding.semantic_uncertainty: The dataset owner publishes no per-column codebook, so the direction of the coding is inferred rather than documented. If a future authoritative statement reversed 0/1 for this column, the fit would be affected; this is registered as residual item S-9 and requires explicit human acceptance before any real-data run.

EF-TTE.clinical_meaning: Left ventricular ejection fraction on transthoracic echocardiography
EF-TTE.missing_semantics: Official source states the dataset has no missing values. A blank cell is treated as an undocumented gap (NaN) and imputed inside training folds only; the literal tokens '?' and '-9' are rejected as wrong-source markers.
EF-TTE.leakage_note: Echocardiographic findings may be recorded during the same admission as angiography and can be affected by the event under study.
EF-TTE.uncertainty: Acquisition time relative to angiography and to any revascularisation is undocumented; RWMA in particular can be a consequence of the ischaemic event being diagnosed.
EF-TTE.exclusion_reason: Excluded from every panel by default: echocardiography timing relative to angiography is unverified (L-08-ECHO) and RWMA may be a consequence rather than a predictor of the outcome. Requires a documented protocol amendment.
